notes.title: 🐟🏪Aquatic Store Simulator Full Release🏪🐟
notes.notes:
Hello gamers

We have just launched  🐟🏪Aquatic Store Simulator🏪🐟

[previewyoutube=PsUPMKioYPA;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a casual and relaxing "supermarket" simulation game where you 

Take on the challenge of managing your underwater-themed supermarket, blending business management with the beauty of marine life. Stock shelves with exotic fish🐙, decorations🖼️, set prices💲, take payments💰 and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073580/Aquatic_Store_Simulator/


You can buy the game even cheaper in a bundle. Check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=aquatic+store+bundle


Have a great time playing,
FreeMind team.
